description: PlotOps is a git-native project tracker in the spirit of Linear and Jira — tasks live next to branches, pull requests, and builds. An open-source portfolio pet project.

kanban.title: Git Kanban
kanban.body: Custom columns, labels, priority, and deadlines. Filter the board, nest subtasks, soft-archive work, and generate branch names like feature/TASK-123-login.

git.title: In-app Git
git.body: Link a branch or PR from the task drawer, review code diffs without leaving PlotOps, open a PR, merge, and see check-run rollups.

cicd.title: CI/CD dashboard
cicd.body: Browse GitHub Actions per branch: run status, jobs, and streaming logs — live polling while builds are in flight.

sprints.title: Sprints & backlog
sprints.body: Board-scoped sprints with backlog, estimates, start/close/cancel, and insights (velocity, burndown) when you plan iterations.

teams.title: Teams & permissions
teams.body: Team → Project hierarchy with roles, invites, and GitHub repo connect. Multi-board setups with base branch and allowed branch patterns.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.body: Rich-text descriptions with images and tables, comments with replies, @mentions, Watch notifications, and a live activity feed.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.body: Ctrl/Cmd+K to search tasks, create work, jump boards/CI/settings, switch projects, and toggle theme without leaving the keyboard.

guest.title: Guest Mode
guest.body: Try the demo without GitHub OAuth — a local sandbox with seeded teams, tasks, fake diffs, and CI logs.

stack: Vite, React 19, TanStack Router & Query, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Supabase (Auth, Postgres, Realtime, Edge Functions), and the GitHub API.
